leadText: Mikael (Japanese: ミカエル Mikael) is a minor recurring character in .
plainText:
Mikael (Japanese: ミカエル Mikael) is a minor recurring character in .

==History==
Mikael first appeared in Curtain Up, Unova League!, where he participated in the Vertress Conference and was 's first opponent. He was shown to be aggressive in . Mikael's strategy was to attack first, with his Watchog seen rushing towards Bianca's Emboar.

In Mission: Defeat Your Rival!, his Watchog was defeated and he was eliminated from the tournament.
